# Extract the crowd numbers from the 'crowd' column as integers
df['crowd_int'] = df['crowd'].astype(int)

# Sort the crowd values in descending order and get the top 3
top_3_crowds = df['crowd_int'].sort_values(ascending=False).head(3).tolist()

# Get the crowd for the collingwood vs melbourne game
collingwood_melbourne_crowd = df.loc[(df['home team'] == 'collingwood') & (df['away team'] == 'melbourne'), 'crowd_int'].iloc[0]

# Check if this crowd is the third largest (i.e., the third element in the sorted top 3 list)
answer = (collingwood_melbourne_crowd == top_3_crowds[2])
